methods.description: Distinguish space taken up from amount a hollow container holds.
Use a familiar size benchmark to choose practical cubic or capacity units.
Order units and recall neighbouring capacity-unit relationships.
Use cm³/mL and m³/kL links, then litre relationships.
Keep the measurement unchanged while choosing a more convenient recorded unit.
